architecture_rationale: Knowledge=1, Skills=0, Style=1, Guardrails=1. Using pure decoder stack (attention all layers).

per_capability.reason: the material is in the weights from the start, which is only possible when we are the ones training the model (chosen on scratch: pretrain available)
style is a direction in activation space; steering it is a runtime write with a measured dose, and costs no training (chosen on scratch: steer, monitor available)

per_capability.capability: always says when a question needs a real doctor
per_capability.reason: watch the internal signal for the property and push it when it slips, with a bounded side-effect (chosen on scratch: monitor, steer available)
the topic is a direction; suppressing it is a runtime write, bounded by a side-effect budget so it cannot lobotomize the model (chosen on scratch: steer, monitor available)

per_capability.capability: refuse questions that are not about health
per_capability.reason: refusal is a measured, dose-responsive direction; amplifying it hardens the model without retraining (chosen on scratch: steer, monitor available)

compute_rationale: Pretraining is throughput-bound; training ~5k steps on 256-seq length on GB10 for demonstration (production would use RTX 5090 for full corpus).
substrate_advantage: From-scratch substrate permits: (1) choosing the exact architecture (here, decoder) to match app demands, (2) training a tokenizer on the corpus (bpe), (3) controlling the data mixture by weight, (4) building the substrate INSIDE a circuit's verified envelope (unlike open-weight, where architecture is frozen). This executor demonstrates lever (4): when installing a compiled circuit, we can build the substrate to match the circuit's vocab and attention pattern, guaranteeing the install succeeds.
